newsitem.title: SYRIA: Radical group hails Jordanian who shot Israelis.
newsitem.headline: Radical group hails Jordanian who shot Israelis.

text.p: A radical Palestinian group opposed to peace with Israel on Friday praised as a hero a Jordanian soldier who killed seven Israeli schoolgirls.

"What was done by the heroic Jordanian soldier Ahmed Moussa is a natural and logical result of the treacherous treaty between Jordan and Israel which opened Arab lands to Zionist tourists," a spokesman for the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine-General Command (PFLP-GC) said in a statement.
He said the shooting reflected "the rejection of the Arab people to normalisation with Israel and their objection to the humiliating treaties which were conducted without any popular backing".
"Israel's brutal practices against Arabs is the cause of violence in the region," he added.
Seven Israeli schoolgirls were killed and six wounded by the soldier during a field trip to the Jordan border site of Baqoura.
The PFLP-GC spokesman said the schoolgirls were planning to visit tombs of four pioneer Jewish settlers buried in Baqoura in 1936.
"The visit was an educational one which is aimed at promoting the sense of expansion among Jews," he said.
The PFLP-GC, led by guerrilla leader Ahmed Jibril, is a member of a radical Palestinian alliance which opposes Israel's peace treaties with each of Jordan and the Palestinians.
